notes.text: In the Deck of Complications game, when a card is Enhanced and it has Dashboard Prompt TRUE, the Storyteller should be sent a Dashboard Prompt again -- just as they were when the card was automated in its unenhanced state.

For some reason, when an automatic custom condition is applied from a Complication flip, if it starts with a minus sign, the minus sign is omitted from the text (e.g. "-2 to  all Social rolls" becomes "2 to all Social rolls"
When a complication card is DISCARDED or NEGATED, all Conditions it created must be cleared from the player.
